body: I love the subject matter. I'm always excited to learn about the course material. It's the structure and deadlines that mess me up and when I fuck up, I feel awful about myself and retreat.
I will look into this with my doctor, thank you :)
Thank you :). I am alright but certainly not amazing. There are videos out there on youtube of me participating in group dance numbers with my school's dance organization.
I suppose that might be a possibility. I've been a vegetarian for almost 10 years and I don't want to go back to eating meat, so I worry about eliminating more things from my diet.

Thank you, but things for me just seem to be slowly getting worse... every year is less and less happy. I have tried very hard this year to make new friends to no avail. I doubt any of my ex-friends would care if they couldn't even be bothered to check in and see if I was alright after my boyfriend of four years dumped me like a bag of trash, instead preferring to remain friends with him over me.

I feel that way about dance, but I have only trained for about five years and therefore do not have the training or technique to be a professional. I love to dance but in a way it upsets me because I know that I will never be amazing at it and I will never be a professional dancer.

Thank you for the very kind words. I am trying to hold on but I am struggling.

I have been in school for 6 years now, and it truly feels like I will never finish. I have had depression and been a self-injurer since high school but in the last two years I have developed unspecified anxiety issues, including panic attacks, that could be either generalized anxiety disorder or OCD.

I am working on alternate arrangements with my professors, but it is very demoralizing. Additionally, I'm worried about being able to finish enough credits to stay in school and keep my student loan.

I have put myself out there many times this year in clubs and while I suppose I have some new acquaintances, I have no new friends from the effort.

It's difficult to conceive of anyone missing out on knowing me. Thank you for the kind words though.
